title: Securing enterprise AI agents: where the controls live, and where authority begins — June 2026

citations.claim: Industry guidance on securing enterprise AI agents recommends engineered controls across the agent lifecycle — distinct agent identity, least-privilege and scoped capability/tool access, human approval for consequential actions, and end-to-end auditability/observability of what an agent did.
citations.publisher: IBM + Anthropic, guidance on securing enterprise AI agents. Cited as published guidance, not as a security or compliance recommendation by KYE Protocol™.

citations.claim: The EU AI Act places logging and human-oversight duties on the deployer of an AI system, discharged at the point of use rather than in a later review.
citations.publisher: Official Journal of the European Union (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
